title: GaiaSeis: GNSS-based real-time seismogeodesy platform
description:
GaiaSeis connects to NTRIP casters, decodes RTCM 3 observation and ephemeris streams, groups each receiver epoch and hands it to a displacement engine plug-in (default: GaiaVario, a variometric engine in its own repository), and publishes the displacement time series as miniSEED files, a SeedLink feed (through ringserver), a web page and a GTK GUI. Written in Julia.

This work is part of the TRANSFORM² project which aims to improve physical and digital infrastructure across Near-Fault Observatories (NFOs) in Europe. TRANSFORM² is funded by the European Union under project number 101188365 within the HORIZON-INFRA-2024-DEV-01-01 call.
